0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The sentry captain fears for the fate of one of his men.

25.original: Search for the amaro once again.

26.original: Use the healing salve on the wounded sentry.

27.original: Report back to the sentry captain.

48.original: Damn it all! We can ill afford to lose another─ Ho there, friend. Might you lend me your aid? One of my best men has yet to return from his patrol, and I fear the worst.

49.original: As you can see, his amaro made it back safely, but my man's nowhere to be found. Could you search for him in my stead? I would go myself, but I can't very well abandon my post.

51.original: Bloody beast! Where do you think you're─ Ah, too late I suppose. But wait... Do you reckon he's gone back for his rider?

52.original: Sorry to trouble you, friend, but do you think you could follow that amaro for us? That scaly brute might be my best chance at finding our man.

53.original: And take this salve with you. I reckon there's a good chance he's out there, too wounded to have made his way back.

54.original: Pray follow that amaro, friend! That beast might be our best hope to track down my missing man.

55.original: The amaro stares intently in the general direction of Dampsole.

57.original: Gah! Damned fiend got me in the leg... I can barely stand, let alone move. Is this the end for me?

58.original: The amaro eyes the wounded soldier with a gaze that could almost be described as concerned. This must be the sentry who was separated from his mount.

60.original: The amaro eyes you with an expectant gaze. You sense it is hoping that you will tend to the man's wounds.

62.original: The amaro eyes you with an expectant gaze. You sense it is hoping that you will tend to the man's wounds.

63.original: Thank you, friend! When the beast knocked me from my mount, I thought it was the end of me for sure! But however did you know where to look?

64.original: My mount led you to me? You don't say!

65.original: I owe you an apology, little fellow... Here I thought you ran off in fear of my foe, but it turns out you were looking for help the whole time. Can you forgive me for doubting you?

67.original: And with that, I'd best head back to the Imperative and let everyone know I'm all right. Thank you, my friend. You saved my life today.

68.original: Ah, there you are. I was hoping that you'd return so I could properly express my gratitude. You'll be happy to know─as I would─that my man has safely returned to the Imperative.

69.original: Those amaro can be stubborn brutes at times, but times like this make a man appreciate what loyal companions they truly are. I'd say this one's earned himself some extra feed for dinner today!
